From cbfe90757d6ff3c670485dacc76a2165125f9a06 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Anton Tananaev <anton.tananaev@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Sep 2018 08:51:41 +1200
Subject: [PATCH] Disable advertising id collection

---
 app/build.gradle                 | 4 ++--
 app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml | 4 ++++
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/app/build.gradle b/app/build.gradle
index 4dd969347..3035207a2 100644
--- a/app/build.gradle
+++ b/app/build.gradle
@@ -9,8 +9,8 @@ android {
         buildConfigField "boolean", "HIDDEN_APP", "false"
         minSdkVersion 15
         targetSdkVersion 28
-        versionCode 50
-        versionName '5.13'
+        versionCode 51
+        versionName '5.14'
     }
 
     lintOptions {
diff --git a/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml b/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
index aeafa9ebf..2769c10e9 100644
--- a/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
+++ b/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
@@ -20,6 +20,10 @@
         android:theme="@style/AppTheme"
         android:name=".MainApplication">
 
+        <meta-data
+            android:name="google_analytics_adid_collection_enabled"
+            android:value="false" />
+
         <activity
             android:name=".MainActivity"
             android:launchMode="singleTask" />

From db427d338bbd284203badb36b25504c7f152b5ea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Olivier Girondel <olivier@biniou.info>
Date: Wed, 26 Sep 2018 00:34:51 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Decode negative latitudes and longitudes (fix #4064)

---
 src/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoder.java      | 6 +++---
 test/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoderTest.java | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoder.java b/src/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoder.java
index 1d80178cbe..a8f74b8764 100644
--- a/src/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoder.java
+++ b/src/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoder.java
@@ -36,8 +36,8 @@ public GpsmtaProtocolDecoder(GpsmtaProtocol protocol) {
     private static final Pattern PATTERN = new PatternBuilder()
             .expression("([^ ]+) ")              // uid
             .number("(d+) ")                     // time (unix time)
-            .number("(d+.d+) ")                  // latitude
-            .number("(d+.d+) ")                  // longitude
+            .number("-?(d+.d+) ")                // latitude
+            .number("-?(d+.d+) ")                // longitude
             .number("(d+) ")                     // speed
             .number("(d+) ")                     // course
             .number("(d+) ")                     // accuracy
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@ public GpsmtaProtocolDecoder(GpsmtaProtocol protocol) {
             .number("(d+) ")                     // flags
             .number("(d+) ")                     // battery
             .number("(d+) ")                     // temperature
-            .number("(d)")                       // changing status
+            .number("(d)")                       // charging status
             .any()
             .compile();
 
diff --git a/test/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoderTest.java b/test/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoderTest.java
index 3160037572..27922bdbcd 100644
--- a/test/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoderTest.java
+++ b/test/org/traccar/protocol/GpsmtaProtocolDecoderTest.java
@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@ public void testDecode() throws Exception {
                 "864528021249771 1446116686 49.85073 24.004438 0 217 6 338 00 59 27 0 0"));
 
         verifyPosition(decoder, text(
-                "359144048138856 1442932957 49.85064 24.003979 1 0 40 0 10 110 26 0 0"));
+                "359144048138856 1442932957 -49.85064 -24.003979 1 0 40 0 10 110 26 0 0"));
 
     }
